The '''Ambush of the Leafar''' occurred in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] when forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] ambushed a [[Leafar]] merchant convoy at an important transfer point near the [[Leafar system/Legends|Leafar system]]. Five [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] were present and began attacking the Imperial forces so as to buy time for the Leafar to escape. Further Rebel reinforcements were then called in for support.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This event is portrayed in Operation 16B (Support for Possible Allies) of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] expansion, [[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit|''Imperial Pursuit'']].
